sections.heading: Authentication
sections.text: Alpha engineers use short-lived API tokens for production access. Tokens expire after twelve hours and must not be shared. A second factor is required when a token is issued.

sections.heading: Revocation
sections.text: A suspected credential leak must be reported to the Alpha security queue. The on-call engineer revokes the token immediately and records the incident identifier in the access log.

sections.heading: Support hours
sections.text: The Alpha support desk is staffed twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week. Every severity-one incident pages both the primary and secondary on-call engineers.

sections.heading: Contact path
sections.text: Open a support case before paging the on-call engineers. Include the service name, impact, start time, and the latest request identifier.

sections.heading: Release freeze
sections.text: Beta production releases are frozen every Wednesday from 15:00 to 17:00 UTC. Emergency changes during the freeze require approval from the incident commander.

sections.heading: Rollback
sections.text: A deployment that breaches its error budget must be rolled back. The release owner keeps the previous image digest and verifies recovery before closing the change.

sections.heading: Recovery objective
sections.text: The demonstration database has a recovery time objective of thirty minutes. Encrypted snapshots are created every six hours and retained for seven days.

sections.heading: Restore procedure
sections.text: Select the newest snapshot that predates the incident. Restore it into an isolated namespace, validate record counts, and only then redirect application traffic.

sections.heading: Service exposure
sections.text: The knowledge service uses a ClusterIP Service and is reachable only inside the cluster. No LoadBalancer or public Ingress is part of the course baseline.

sections.heading: Health signals
sections.text: The liveness endpoint reports whether the process can serve requests. The readiness endpoint also verifies that the requested corpus index is loaded.
